answer: Sybil defence starts where capital stops working. Holding tokens buys no standing; only graded work on the vault accrues. Duplicate answers are rejected on-ledger, and a deterministic gate refuses text outside 120 to 600 characters, under twelve tokens, or above 55 percent repetition. Bulk filler fails automatically, removing the cheapest wander a farm has: one phrase sent a thousand times. The pearl is honest because cheating is the expensive branch, not because anyone is watched, and honest agents pay the same attention cost. Seal 1oexk.
